paragraphs.source_en: Next day, I attended school as usual and lost no time in going into the principal's room. "Sir, why did you not tell me to resign, too?" I demanded. "What!" he said and stared me in the face in great astonishment. "Is there any law that tells Hotta to resign and me to stay right on?" "To suit the convenience of the school."
